name: [newspaper] ingest-news did not run
message: The news ingest has not reported a run in 25 hours, so no new articles are arriving. Check the Vercel cron logs, then run it by hand: GET /api/cron/ingest-news?force=1 with the header Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>.

name: [newspaper] refresh-candles did not run
message: The price history refresh has not reported a run in 25 hours, so charts are going stale. Check the Vercel cron logs for /api/cron/refresh-candles.

name: [newspaper] cleanup-old-news did not run
message: The article cleanup has not reported a run in 25 hours, so the collection is growing past its retention. Check the Vercel cron logs for /api/cron/cleanup-old-news.

name: [newspaper] sync-vectors did not run
message: The Pinecone sync has not reported a run in 25 hours, so new articles are not searchable. Check the Vercel cron logs for /api/cron/sync-vectors.

name: [newspaper] a cron job failed
message: {{job.name}} reported a failed run. Check its Vercel logs. This alert clears on its own 25 hours after the failure, even if a re-run succeeds, or it can be resolved by hand.

name: [newspaper] a news feed returned nothing
message: {{source.name}} {{category.name}} returned no articles on every ingest in the last 25 hours. The feed URL may have moved or the feed may be down.
